## Higgsfield AI is a complete rip-off. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!
Absolutely one of the WORST AI platforms I have ever used. Higgsfield AI feels like a complete SCAM and an absolute money-grabbing machine.  
  
You pay ridiculous amounts of money expecting a premium AI video generation service, but what you actually get is an overpriced, frustrating, painfully slow, and completely unreliable experience.  
  
Let's talk about their so-called "UNLIMITED" mode. WHAT A JOKE. You can literally wait TWO HOURS for a SINGLE VIDEO GENERATION. TWO HOURS! And after waiting all that time, there's a good chance the result will be absolute garbage. Wrong movements, ignored instructions, broken animations, terrible consistency, and outputs that look nothing like what you requested. [...] Their "Unlimited" mode feels practically useless when you have to wait forever for a single generation. What is the point of unlimited generations when producing anything worthwhile takes an eternity?  
  
As someone who actually works with video editing and AI-generated content, I expect tools to improve my workflow, NOT destroy my productivity.  
  
Higgsfield has been nothing but wasted time, wasted money, endless frustration, and disappointment.  
  
I genuinely regret spending money on this platform.  
  
My advice: DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY ON HIGGSFIELD AI. Don't fall for the flashy advertisements and impressive promotional videos. The reality of using this service can be an absolute nightmare.  
  
If I could give ZERO STARS, I WOULD.  
  
One star is already too generous. [...] ## Good tool overall, but strict and unfair credit refund policy
I have been using Higgsfield, and overall the generation results for other tasks have been good. However, my recent experience with customer support regarding a credit refund was very disappointing.  
I used 105 credits on a Genjutsu generation where the reference source clearly had a female posture, but the output completely messed it up and rendered it as a male pose template instead. When I contacted support, they flat out refused to return the credits simply because the system marked the task as  
"completed" rather than "failed".  
It feels unfair that users are charged full credits for incorrect, unusable outputs caused by system errors, with zero flexibility from support.

results.title: Higgsfield's TOS Backlash: What Changed and What Didn't | MindStudio
results.content:
Beyond the legal document itself, complaints logged on Higgsfield’s Discord describe a pattern of difficulty canceling subscriptions, credits deducted despite time remaining in a billing cycle, and users needing to track down a specific moderator to resolve account issues. Some of these were resolved after enough friction (credits refunded, cancellations processed), but the friction itself is the point: a platform that makes leaving difficult while marketing “unlimited” plans with heavy fine print raises separate trust questions from the terms of service alone. [...] ### Are Higgsfield’s subscription and cancellation issues related to the terms of service controversy?

They’re a separate but related problem. Users have reported difficulty canceling subscriptions, credit deductions during active billing cycles, and needing direct contact with moderators to resolve issues. These complaints point to broader concerns about the platform’s monetization practices beyond the specific legal language in its terms.
